Sep 2026 • Couples
Our stay at La Siesta was wonderful, and every staff member was incredibly kind and welcoming.

One of the things we especially liked was the peaceful atmosphere. There weren’t many Chinese tour groups, and most of the guests were Korean or Western families, so the hotel was quiet and relaxing.

The breakfast was delicious as well, and all the staff were very friendly. We especially want to thank DAT for the thoughtful and attentive care throughout our stay. We truly appreciated it.

Now I understand why La Siesta is so popular among Korean travelers.

Highly recommended!
